verdict.rationale: Jira's own product page says Atlassian ships a CLI for AI workflows ('our MCP and CLI') and promises AI coding agents terminal access to the Teamwork Graph, so the official CLI is first-party claimed. The evidence is only two marketing sentences, with no CLI documentation, command reference or hands-on use. Community-written API wrapper scripts are a user workaround and the MCP server is a separate capability, so neither earns credit here. missing for 10: named CLI product docs, install/auth instructions, command reference for Jira operations, agent-oriented features (e.g. JSON output, non-interactive mode), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
